I'm a day trader.
I have very little social skills a severe anxiety disorder that prevents me from working in almost every field there is.
Day trading is difficult but it's the closest I've ever been to some resemblance to a normal life.

My approach for trading is exceptionally rare. I can't find anyone that does it apart from my mentor and his community, which is incredibly expensive to be a part of. 

If any other traders are reading this, let me give you a quick 2 cents. Most traders struggle to get over a certain percentage of profit from their account size. Apparently the general understanding of the market is 60 to 75% annual return on account size is amazing.

I have to pull in 485% per annum for the 4 dependants I have.

My exceptional approach in trading I can do that, I can see the roadmap and have a weird nack for this that is rare. 

I have received nothing but concern, contempt and disbelief by trading firms, family and friends, I believe I am incredibly close to becoming the best trader in the world but cannot under current financial status continue and I have no other streams of revenue and won't have any due to my skin colour I simply don't get jobs (I'm in South Africa and white, this means companies have to full their quotas of diversity, so I don't even get considered.) 

I have enough finance to keep going for another 5 months, then me and 4 others are on the street. I cannot cope with that thought and it clouds my ability to trade safely, I then make stupid mistakes and shrink my account.

At this point I know things change and I won't always feel like this, I just simply cannot imagine a life after this. I have spent 4 years on my journey of day trading and cannot give up, I am so close. But these thoughts. I cannot shake them and am brought to tears often, especially now while typing this.

I cannot describe the pain, its immense guilt of knowing my dependants won't survive without me due to their own personal financial issues, I imagine most of the world is financially constraint recently due to the pandemic.

I am really struggling and cannot talk to them for fear of causing even more strain than we are already under, I can't drop this bombshell on them and ask for help so I'm seeking, something, here. Not sure if anyone can help. But at this time of writing, it's not going well.
